name: signal recognition particle 54

function.text: SRP54 encodes signal recognition particle subunit SRP54. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and endoplasmic reticulum signal sequence receptor activity. It participates in granulocyte differentiation and neutrophil chemotaxis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neutropenia, severe congenital, 8, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

function.text: SRP54 encodes signal recognition particle subunit SRP54. Based in part on similarity, it forms part of the signal recognition particle (SRP) complex, a ribonucleoprotein complex that mediates the cotranslational targeting of secretory and membrane proteins to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER). It binds to the signal sequence of presecretory proteins when they emerge from the ribosomes. It displays basal GTPase activity, and stimulates reciprocal GTPase activation of the SR subunit SRPRA.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with neutropenia, severe congenital, 8, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).
